run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
create_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple frames
compute_gtn_forward_loss: compute the forward loss by intersecting target and emission graphs and scoring with GTN
compute_gtn_backward_gradients: compute backward gradients for each batch example using GTN backward pass in parallel
build_gtn_loss_function: build a custom PyTorch autograd loss function using GTN graphs for frame-to-token sequence alignment
